name: paper-figure-skill
description: Create or accept a paper-figure master, regenerate its fine-grained visual parts as transparent assets, and recompose them as an editable PowerPoint.

interface.shortDescription: Build editable research figures in PowerPoint
interface.longDescription: Give Paper Figure Skill a paper or a reference figure. It maps the composition, creates reusable transparent assets, rebuilds native text, shapes, and connectors in PowerPoint, and delivers visual-verification evidence.
defaultPrompt: Regenerate every fine-grained visual asset from this master figure with a transparent background, then recompose an editable PowerPoint at the original positions.
Create a complete method-figure master from this paper, regenerate its fine-grained UI and icon assets, and compose an editable verified PowerPoint.
